name: coreforge-books-mcp

tools.name: catalogue_lookup
tools.description: Look up a book in the CoreForge catalogue by ISBN or by title text. Returns metadata, prices and live retailer status. Paid via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

title.description: Title text (substring match) — used when no ISBN is given

tools.name: catalogue_title
tools.description: Fetch the full CoreForge catalogue record for one ISBN (metadata, prices, live retailer status). Paid via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Search book data by title text and/or author over the CoreForge Memory dossier store (~1.17M book dossiers) merged with the CoreForge catalogue. Returns dossier summaries (use book_record for a full dossier) plus catalogue matches. Paid via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

tools.name: book_record
tools.description: Fetch one full book enrichment record (the complete dossier JSON) from the CoreForge Memory store by dossier id (bk_<16 hex chars>, from book_search). Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

tools.name: chapter_verdict
tools.description: Gate-style heuristic verdict on one fiction chapter (200–400,000 characters): a 1–5 score and binge-worthy flag computed from restatement (repeated passages), dialogue share, a complaint-marker screen and tempo/middle-sag profile. Deterministic — no language model. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

text.description: The chapter text to score (at least 200 characters)

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Deterministic token risk verdict from public DEX market data (liquidity depth, market age, volume/liquidity balance, buy/sell balance, market structure): a 0–100 score, band and flags. Not financial advice. Paid via x402 ($0.02 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

address.description: Token address: an EVM 0x… contract address or a Solana mint address

tools.name: meter_estimate
tools.description: CoreForge Meter GPU-cost estimate: total estimated cost for running a GPU type for a number of hours, computed from public cloud GPU list prices, with the cheapest option as the basis plus alternatives. Estimate only, not a quote. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

gpu.description: GPU type, e.g. 'H100', 'RTX 4090', 'L40S' (see meter_gpus for names)

tools.name: meter_gpus
tools.description: Free: list the GPU types CoreForge Meter can price (id, display name, VRAM) — use it to form a valid meter_estimate query. No payment required.
